name: Folder
description: Hierarchical folder for organizing files. Each row has a name, an optional parentFolderId, and ancestor data for fast tree queries. Folders may be platform-managed (internal) or user-created. ACL is read-only via generic CRUD: folder lifecycle goes through FileController (create-folder, rename, delete), which maintains the ancestor data and folderType invariants that direct CRUD would corrupt.

attributes.name: idOfUser
attributes.description: Owner. representsOwnership drives the ownership filter (52-D.2 / 52-D.3).

attributes.name: folderType
attributes.description: Type in Trillo such as 'gen_ai'. This is also use to create subfolder within tenant folder

attributes.name: internal
attributes.description: A folder marked internal is not included in the folder-tree

attributes.name: appId
attributes.description: Plan-57 — app this folder belongs to (schema selector). Stamped at create from the request's appId; immutable. In MA mode this is part of the bucket prefix; in SA mode it stays 0 (the DDL default).

attributes.name: bucketPath
attributes.description: Plan-57 — full bucket-relative prefix for this folder's contents. Stamped at create; immutable across rename / move. New files take {bucketPath}/{fileId}.{ext}. NULL on rows created before plan-57; BaseFileService.resolveBucketPath falls back to the legacy folder-ancestry-derived path in that case.

attributes.name: managed
attributes.description: Plan-57 — true only for folders under a managed-document tree (the UI navigates these). Defaults from the folderType catalog at create time.

attributes.name: publicAccess
attributes.description: Plan-57 — true if files in this folder live under the pub/ bucket prefix (anonymous read). Defaults from the folderType catalog at create time; per-folder override possible.

attributes.name: dropbox
attributes.description: Plan-72 — drop-box folder: any permitted user (incl. guest) may upload; files are owned by the folder owner (not the uploader) and only the owner (later, folder-share grantees) can read them. Mutually exclusive with publicAccess.

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.description: Plan-75 — semantic folder purpose driving upload/read access. null = default (owner-private). "common" = any authenticated user uploads (owner = folder owner) and any authenticated user reads. Mutually exclusive with dropbox (dropbox wins). Subfolders inherit it. Custom behavior is delegated to a function, not more built-in purposes.
